name: radar-for-claude-code
displayName: Radar for Claude Code: 💬 working, ⚠️ needs you, 🟢 done, 🤖 agents
description: Claude Code multitasking, done right. Run it across a handful of projects and each window title shows what its Claude is up to: working, needs you, or done. When Claude fans out into subagents, the title counts them live: 💬 14m 🤖8. Turn on native tabs and your tab bar becomes a live status board, so you always know which project to jump to next. Plus a banner and sound when a window's in the background. macOS only.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Radar never runs code from the workspace. It only watches its own marker files in ~/.claude/tab-status and shows a title marker.

claudeRadar.markerWorking.description: Shown while Claude is working. Always visible, no banner or sound. Just the emoji, the space is added for you.

claudeRadar.showWorkingTime.description: Append how long Claude has been working to the working marker (💬 14m). Updates once a minute.

claudeRadar.markerAgents.description: Shown before the number of subagents currently running in this project (💬 14m 🤖8), e.g. during a multi-agent review. Just the emoji; empty hides the count.

claudeRadar.markerWaiting.description: Shown when Claude needs you (a question or a permission). Just the emoji.

claudeRadar.markerDone.description: Shown when Claude is done. Just the emoji.

claudeRadar.markerError.description: Shown instead of the done marker when the turn failed: its last tool call failed, or Claude's side died on it (spend limit, overload, expired session). Just the emoji; empty falls back to no marker.

claudeRadar.detectQuestions.description: Treat a turn that ends by asking you something as "needs you" (⚠️) instead of "done". Claude Code reports a typed question as a plain turn end, so without this the question sits there unanswered.

claudeRadar.banner.description: Show a macOS banner when Claude needs you or is done (background windows only).

claudeRadar.minDoneSeconds.description: Only show the done banner when the turn ran at least this many seconds. 0 shows every one. Questions, permissions, and failures always notify, however short the turn was.

claudeRadar.soundWaiting.description: Sound when Claude needs you. macOS sound name, empty for silent.

claudeRadar.soundDone.description: Sound when Claude is done. Empty for silent.

claudeRadar.soundError.description: Sound when a turn failed. Empty for silent.

claudeRadar.shellTasksKeepWorking.description: Keep the working marker while a background shell task Claude started (e.g. a dev server) is still running. When off, only subagents, workflows, and monitors hold the working state after a turn ends.
